saved mask was written by C10 via its else-branch (no checkpoint existed yet): region SST for 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 was pooled per day of year (±5-day windows, all 121 days per pool, covering every baseline date) into hazen 90th-percentile thresholds, with day 60 interpolated and then smoothed by a dense 366x366 matrix product that takes every per-day threshold as an input.
